text: Ward 11 has a vibrant and popular collection of small theatres which host a variety of performances, including the heart of the ever-popular Toronto Fringe festival. These small theatres are essential for Toronto’s performing arts community and for everyone who benefits from their performances. Unfortunately, many of these theatres are in desperate need of upgrades, particularly for accessibility, climate resilience, and performance quality. Capital funds for these purposes have been in very short supply for a long time. TRANZAC, at 292 Brunswick Avenue, is a vibrant not-for-profit performance arts organization dedicated to nurturing artistic expression and fostering community connections. The building contains three performance spaces that accommodate audiences of 20 to 150 people each. TRANZAC has a long history of supporting the performing arts.
